name: Acer Synergy Tech Corp.
summary: Acer Synergy Tech Corp. specializes in delivering a comprehensive suite of information technology solutions and related services. Their enterprise architecture offerings encompass strategic planning and design for critical IT components like computer rooms, networks, and overall infrastructure. This also includes managing virtual desktops, overseeing information security monitoring, developing business continuity strategies, and crafting virtual architecture plans. The company further excels in information system integration, handling tasks such as the complete construction of computer room networks, meticulous installation and configuration of networks, and the building, installation, and fine-tuning of infrastructure, alongside associated design and implementation services. For ongoing operational support, Acer Synergy Tech delivers information infrastructure maintenance services. These cover server and storage equipment monitoring and upkeep, managing maintenance for data center networks and communications, virtual system support, terminal desktop management, and troubleshooting for other office automation (OA) equipment. Their outsourcing capabilities include managing outsourced IT personnel, supplying short-term staffing, and offering project-specific support. Additionally, Acer Synergy Tech develops intelligent innovation solutions, spanning areas such as terminal devices, public sector applications, industry-specific uses, scenario-based applications, core technology platforms, and both cloud and fundamental computing services. Established in 2017, the company's headquarters are located in Zhubei, Taiwan.
